statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because NQ is closed and no persistent one-way price path can be observed; Stress remains extreme as the Riyadh airport incident, Saudi crude-routing disruption and constrained Hormuz traffic remain unresolved.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is below the WATCH threshold; weekend geopolitical and energy uncertainty remains represented primarily in Stress until futures reopen and live price discovery can test directional persistence.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress as weekend Saudi and shipping risks persist
body: NQ futures are closed, so current continuation, shallow-pullback, failed-retracement and session-extreme behavior cannot be verified. Reuters reporting keeps the Riyadh airport incident, Saudi crude-routing disruption and constrained Hormuz traffic in focus. Fresh shared Finviz context from 13:30:27Z is partial and latest-session only: semiconductors were 5 positive / 2 negative and megacaps 4 / 4, while futures and calendar were unavailable.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail peaked at 24% during Friday's event/whipsaw phase and then fell sharply as the session ended with two-way structure. Weekend Tail stayed low while Stress rose back into the extreme band as Saudi security, oil-route and shipping uncertainty accumulated.
outlookSummary: All 24 forecast slots remain before the Sunday NQ futures reopening. Saudi security, crude-routing and Hormuz headlines can change reopening-gap expectations and keep Stress extreme, but persistent no-retracement Tail cannot be confirmed while NQ is closed; all future market reactions are conditional.
